purpose: Store the character's species-layer selections, adjudications and grant/provenance receipts without copying the SpeciesDefinition.
source_basis: PROJECT_BIBLE_OPS3_REFERENCE.md §9.3-9.6 staged creation, validation and migration
PROJECT_BIBLE_OPS3_REFERENCE.md §10.1-10.3 character aggregate, authored/granted distinctions and grant provenance
DB-004 characters-and-progression.md character aggregate and event/provenance requirements

species_ref.rule: the selection pins the canonical species identity/version; it does not embed the SpeciesDefinition

layer_reference_policy.lineage_selections: references/receipts only; inheritance semantics are MVPS-08
layer_reference_policy.form_selection: reference/receipt only; transformation semantics are MVPS-09
layer_reference_policy.adaptation_selections: references/receipts only; environment semantics are later MVPS tranches
layer_reference_policy.choice_receipts: opaque choice receipts at MVPS-01; budget/legality transaction semantics are MVPS-02

grant_receipts.rule: a character-visible grant is canonical only when its source and reason can be recovered

authored_vs_granted_policy.rule: authored selections and resulting grants remain distinguishable and traceable
